resource "aws_iam_role" "obs_forwarder" {
  name = "obs-forwarder-${var.env}"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [ { Action = "sts:AssumeRole", Principal = { Service = "ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com" }, Condition = { StringEquals = { "aws:SourceAccount" = var.monitoring_account } } } ]
  })
}
```
